description: Create the Abp.Mapperly package with all source files, project configuration, and solution integration. This includes the csproj, FodyWeavers, AssemblyInfo, configuration interfaces, module class, object mapper implementation, and solution file update.
steps: Create directory structure: src/Abp.Mapperly/ and src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/ and src/Abp.Mapperly/Properties/

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj following the pattern of src/Abp.AutoMapper/Abp.AutoMapper.csproj: target net10.0, import common.props and configureawait.props, reference Abp.csproj, add PackageReference to Riok.Mapperly version 4.1.1, set RootNamespace to Abp, set AssemblyName and PackageId to Abp.Mapperly, include GenerateDocumentationFile, disable auto-generated assembly attributes same as AutoMapper project, set Description to Abp.Mapperly, add PackageTags including mapperly and object mapper
Create src/Abp.Mapperly/FodyWeavers.xml with same content as src/Abp.AutoMapper/FodyWeavers.xml (ConfigureAwait ContinueOnCapturedContext=false)
Create src/Abp.Mapperly/FodyWeavers.xsd with same content as src/Abp.AutoMapper/FodyWeavers.xsd

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs following src/Abp.AutoMapper/Properties/AssemblyInfo.cs pattern but with title Abp.Mapperly and product Abp.Mapperly, InternalsVisibleTo Abp.Mapperly.Tests

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/IAbpMapperlyConfiguration.cs - interface with a List<Action<MapperlyConfigurationContext>> Configurators property. MapperlyConfigurationContext is a simple class that holds the IIocManager reference so users can register custom mappers.
Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/AbpMapperlyConfiguration.cs - implementation of IAbpMapperlyConfiguration with the Configurators list initialized in constructor
Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/MapperlyConfigurationContext.cs - a class with IIocManager property that is passed to configurators so they can register mapper instances

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/AbpMapperlyConfigurationExtensions.cs - static class with extension method on IModuleConfigurations returning IAbpMapperlyConfiguration (pattern: configurations.AbpConfiguration.Get<IAbpMapperlyConfiguration>())

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/IMapperlyMapper.cs - interface that user-defined Mapperly mapper classes should implement, with methods: object Map(object source, Type sourceType, Type destinationType); TDestination Map<TDestination>(object source); TDestination Map<TSource, TDestination>(TSource source, TDestination destination); IQueryable<TDestination> ProjectTo<TDestination>(IQueryable source); bool CanMap(Type sourceType, Type destinationType);

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/MapperlyObjectMapper.cs - implements Abp.ObjectMapping.IObjectMapper. Constructor takes IEnumerable<IMapperlyMapper> or uses IIocManager to resolve all IMapperlyMapper instances. Map<TDestination>(object source) iterates registered mappers and calls the first one where CanMap returns true. Map<TSource,TDestination> same pattern. ProjectTo<TDestination> same pattern. Throws AbpException if no mapper can handle the types.

Create src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/AbpMapperlyModule.cs - ABP module class decorated with [DependsOn(typeof(AbpKernelModule))]. In PreInitialize: register IAbpMapperlyConfiguration as AbpMapperlyConfiguration, call Configuration.ReplaceService<ObjectMapping.IObjectMapper, MapperlyObjectMapper>(). In PostInitialize: use ITypeFinder to find all types implementing IMapperlyMapper, register them in Castle Windsor as IMapperlyMapper (all implementations), then call configurators. Inject ITypeFinder in constructor.
Add the new project to Abp.sln using 'dotnet sln add' command: dotnet sln Abp.sln add src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj --solution-folder src
Run dotnet restore and dotnet build on src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj to verify it compiles successfully
acceptance_criteria: src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj references Riok.Mapperly 4.1.1 and ProjectReference to ../Abp/Abp.csproj
src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/AbpMapperlyModule.cs exists, depends on AbpKernelModule, registers configuration and replaces IObjectMapper
src/Abp.Mapperly/Mapperly/IMapperlyMapper.cs exists as the interface for user-defined mappers
The project is listed in Abp.sln
dotnet build src/Abp.Mapperly/Abp.Mapperly.csproj succeeds with exit code 0
verification: dotnet sln Abp.sln list | grep Abp.Mapperly

The dotnet sln add command expanded solution configuration platforms to include x64 and x86 in addition to the existing Any CPU - this is standard dotnet CLI behavior. Build succeeded with 0 errors (only pre-existing warnings from the Abp core project).
